summary_en: Kamgras 1 Corporation raised the public tender offer price for Kakaku.com shares to 3,680 yen (from 3,571 yen) and the self-share acquisition price to 2,992 yen (from 2,903 yen). Digital Garage agreed to the revised terms as part of the planned transaction to take Kakaku.com private.
title_en: Notice Regarding Changes to Terms of Public Tender Offer for Shares of Equity Method Affiliate (Kakaku.com Inc.) and Revision of Anticipated Extraordinary Gain (Individual Settlement Accounts)
translation_en_brief:
Kamgras 1 Corporation, a subsidiary of Kamgras 2 Corporation (which is ultimately owned by EQT AB), raised the public tender offer price for Kakaku.com shares from 3,571 yen to 3,680 yen per share. Concurrently, the self-share acquisition price—applicable after a stock consolidation in a squeeze-out procedure—was increased from 2,903 yen to 2,992 yen per share. Digital Garage, which holds a 20.68% stake in Kakaku.com as of March 31, 2026, consented to these revised terms. The company had previously signed a non-response agreement with the tender offeror.

The background to the price increases included competing proposals from LINE Yahoo and Bain Capital, announced between mid-May and late July 2026. Digital Garage prioritized executing the transaction on EQT's timetable to realize synergies early, while considering the take-private transaction optimal for Kakaku.com's medium to long-term growth and enterprise value. The revised prices are structured so that Digital Garage's after-tax proceeds from the self-share acquisition—where a deemed dividend deduction is expected under Japanese corporate tax law—match the after-tax proceeds it would receive if it tendered at the public offer price, ensuring the company does not benefit relative to other Kakaku.com shareholders.
